Thus the explicit Lean witness follows directly from the source formula and ordinary definitions.

rationale: The repaired proposition explicitly formalizes the canonical obstruction behind Exercise 2.7.4. Its MGF is 1 for every lambda; hence the exact property-(c) inequality holds throughout 0 <= lambda <= 1, but fails at an allowed negative lambda because exp(lambda) < 1. The target preserves the absolute value on X, the unchanged right-hand side exp(K3 lambda), the positive K3 convention, and the full lambda constraints. Both implication directions therefore hold under the source's exercise-as-counterexample semantics.
